profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Experienced System Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the semiconductors industry. Skilled in Java, Android Development, Embedded C, Debugging, and HAL. Strong arts and design professional with a BS focused in Computer Science from University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Starline Project -> Google Beam
Android OS stability, OS update, Design OS Architect.

positions.title: System Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Solana Saga Web3 Phone (OSOM made)
As System Software Engineer worked with Google and Qcom on Android Upgrade, CTS test, and debugging any issue.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Duo, Duo2 - Creating Factory OS, Android Display and Camera - Kernel, HAL, Framework side

positions.title: Graphic System Engineer
positions.description:
Clear Linux GFX Graphics System Engineer
working on Graphic related issue on Clear Linux.
Debugging, Feature adding on UI and Display Kernel.

Tiger Lake Board bring up (Clear Linux + intel Kernel)
Compute Runtime, IGC, gmmlib and mesa graphics on the board.

Clearlinux gfx feature adding
ffmpeg, bazel, darkflow, tensorflow, compute runtime, igc, gmmlib, opencl headers, etc
maintainance + debugging compiling issue. bazel compiling issue debugging.

positions.title: Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description:
working on new chip set with latest Android OS. 
debugging graphic related issue on driver side and kernel,
release new UFO drivers and gate keeping changes.
Broxton power on, Board Bring up (latest Android + latest intel kernel)
Display kernel maintainance and debugging.

Icelake power on, Board bring up (latest Android + latest intel kernel)
Display kernel maintainance and debugging.

Gorden Peak(Android car) Board bring up, Display kernel debugging, 
working with customer for debugging and feature adding

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Google G watch, Board bring up, Display kernel debugging, feature adding (always on display)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on Android Graphic,
ICS update on LG prada device
GB update on LG product
OpenMP and OpenCV for array camera processing on Android
Nexus 4 project, Board bring up, Display kernel debugging
Nexus 5 project, Board bring up, Display kernel debugging, feature adding (wifi display)
